items.content: Comprehensive research sub-agent launched for building self-improving Hyperliquid trading agent (2026-02-01 13:11 UTC). Goal: Win trades, maximize profit, minimize loss, understand market patterns, time entries/exits, make informed automated decisions using news and alpha.

Researching 11 GitHub repos for patterns, strategies, and approaches: HammerGPT/Hyper-Alpha-Arena, hyperliquid-ai-trading-bot, molt-bot/openclaw-trading-assistant (including clawdbot-2.0 release), rz0718/hyperliquid-monitor, NoFxAiOS/nofx, openclaw/skills (hyperliquid-trading), cryptole0/Hyperliquid-maket-making-bot, chainstacklabs/hyperliquid-trading-bot, BankrBot/openclaw-skills, BankrBot (2026-02-01 13:11 UTC)

Research deliverables: Analyze trading strategies/patterns from each repo, identify Hyperliquid bot best practices, news/alpha sources for informed decisions, market timing strategies, risk management approaches, comprehensive agent architecture, data sources/APIs/tools needed, decision-making framework, self-improvement loop design (2026-02-01 13:11 UTC)
Sub-agent session 'hyperliquid-trading-research' spawned with GLM 4.7 model (cost-optimized), 30-minute timeout. Research in progress (2026-02-01 13:11 UTC)
User plans to fund trading wallet when research is complete (2026-02-01 13:11 UTC)

Research completed with 45,000-word comprehensive strategy document (2026-02-01 ~13:34 UTC). Analyzed 10+ repositories including HammerGPT/Hyper-Alpha-Arena, hyperliquid-ai-trading-bot, molt-bot/openclaw-trading-assistant. Key findings: 4-model AI consensus (News, Technical, On-Chain, Risk), RAG memory for avoiding repeated mistakes, 1-2% position sizing limits, 10% drawdown shield, Trump Tracker for high-impact posts. Document location: /home/desktop/clawd/hyperliquid-trading-agent-strategy.md

Strategy evolved to focus on meme coin sniping and smaller cap coins (2026-02-01 ~13:54 UTC). User wants to capitalize on sniping and quick entries/exits to look for profit opportunities. Initial research findings showed grid trading and market making as best practices, but user pivoted toward higher-risk meme coin approach.

User reconsidered risk tolerance (2026-02-01 ~13:56 UTC). Questioned if meme sniping was too risky, asked for more affordable fee strategy than Bitcoin that's also safer. User thought Hyperliquid had no gas fees. Clarified that all perps on Hyperliquid have same trading fees (maker 0.01%, taker 0.035%) but no gas fees for perp trading.

Test budget established at $100 with goal of reaching $5,000 (50x return) (2026-02-01 ~13:57 UTC). Presented realistic math: grid trading takes 15-20 years to 50x, funding arb takes 8-12 years, meme sniping offers 1 week to never timeline (lottery ticket), compounding at 10% monthly takes ~40 months. User needs to choose between yolo $100 on memes, use $100 to learn then scale, or add more capital.

Parallel testing approach decided (2026-02-01 ~14:00 UTC). User wants to paper trade both funding arbitrage and meme coin trading in two different tests simultaneously. Also expressed interest in copy trading Chainstack Labs Hyperliquid bot. Dual approach lets user compare strategy performance without risking real money.

Infrastructure sub-agent launched 'hyperliquid-infrastructure-setup' (2026-02-01 ~14:02 UTC). Goal: Set up complete paper trading infrastructure with dual strategy testing. Deliverables: Docker setup script, Hummingbot configuration files for funding arb and meme grid strategies, tracking spreadsheet template, README with instructions, daily reporting script. Save location: /home/desktop/clawd/hyperliquid-trading-setup/

Learning-focused approach emphasized (2026-02-01 ~14:03 UTC). User stated 'I want whatever is best for you to learn' - giving Clawd autonomy to set up trading infrastructure that enables learning and continuous improvement. Clawd will track setup experience, trade performance, error patterns, and user experience to improve future guidance.
